Listening for

04 / A little background

Research is also
about the conversations.

I hold an M.Tech. in Electrical Engineering from NIT Warangal. My research experience includes speech processing, physiological sensing, graph representations of speech and machine learning for healthcare.

Conferences are an opportunity to explain a paper, work through questions and hear different perspectives. The discussions around my poster — and the input and feedback people shared — were among the most enjoyable parts of these trips.
